title: How do I add background documents?
intent: This article explains how to add background documents that appear alongside the survey.
short_answer: Background documents are files displayed to respondents on every page of the survey, typically in a sidebar. Add them through survey Properties. These can be reference documents, guidelines, or supporting materials.
prerequisites: Documents must be in an uploadable format
procedure: Navigate to the Background Documents section.
The document appears as a download link on every survey page.
important_conditions: Background documents appear on every page of the survey.
Documents can optionally remain visible on the unavailability page after unpublishing.
Documents are displayed alphabetically in the sidebar.
File uploads must meet size limitations.
troubleshooting: Document not visible: Ensure properties were saved and changes applied if published.
